SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. Or D. & R.
CENTRAL I. B. Station.
Date January 31, 1929.）

Subject (in full) Mrs. E. Y. Tuesova.

Made by F.C.J. Maklaevsky Forwarded by J.W. Givens A.B. Pol.

Mrs. E.Y. Tuesova, owner of a boarding house at
31 Haskell Road, is reported to be a bolshevik sympathizer.
Her house is known as a rendez-vous for soviet agents
arriving in Shanghai from Vladivostock by boats plying
between these two ports.

I. Maklaevsky
F. C. J.

A.D.C.I.

Lar
1/2

Ref. No. d/January 31, 1929.

H.B.M. Consul
Lieut. Col. G.H.R. Halland,O.B.E., N. China Command.
Capt: J. P. Shelley, North China Command.
Lieut.E. F. Carlson, U.S. Marine Corps. 1/2-8

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记室
编号 I. Or D. & R.
中央巡捕房情报股。
日期：1929年1月31日。）

事由（全称）：E.Y. 图埃索娃夫人。

呈报人：F.C.J. 马克拉耶夫斯基 转呈人：J.W. 吉文斯，警员

据报，哈斯克尔路31号寄宿舍业主 E.Y. 图埃索娃夫人系布尔什维克同情者。其住所被视为苏联特工的聚会点，这些特工乘坐往返于符拉迪沃斯托克与上海两港之间的船只抵达上海。

I. 马克拉耶夫斯基
F. C. J.

助理刑事侦缉督察
